map.输入公交发车间隔或具体时刻表与当前时间，估算下一班车的到达时刻与已等待时长，支持: Enter headway or a specific timetable plus the current time to estimate the next bus arrival and elapsed waiting time; multiple routes can be compared at once.
map.起点到本站行驶时间 (分钟): Travel time from terminus to this stop (minutes)
map.把前一条线的预计到达时刻加上步行与候车时间，再叠加换乘线路的发车间隔，判断能否赶: Add walking and waiting time to the first route's estimated arrival, then add the connecting route's headway to judge whether you can catch the connection. When the two routes have similar headways, keep a buffer of 5 minutes or more.
map.固定间隔只是计划值，实际受路况、红绿灯、上下客时长与驾驶节奏影响会波动。精确到站: A fixed headway is only a planned value; actual arrivals vary with traffic, signals, boarding time and driving style. For exact arrival trust onboard GPS feeds; this estimate suits rough planning when no live data is available.
map.💡 早高峰与平峰发车间隔通常不同，建议按所在时段选用对应间隔；跨零点线路应注意时: 💡 Peak and off-peak headways usually differ, so use the interval that matches your time of day; for services running past midnight watch for the timetable day rollover.
map.候车乘客输入线路发车间隔或时刻表与当前时间，估算下一班车到达时刻与已等待时长，决: Waiting passengers enter the headway or timetable plus current time to estimate the next arrival and elapsed wait, then decide whether to switch routes or keep waiting.
map.多线路比选时，并列查看各线下一班预计到达，选择最快出发的方案。: When comparing routes, view each line's next predicted arrival side by side and pick the fastest departure.
map.调度或家属远程查看时，用平均间隔加站点偏移粗略预估，作为实时 GPS 数据的补充: Dispatchers or family members checking remotely use average headway plus a stop offset as a rough backup to real-time GPS data.
